# Shared lesson publication remains provisional

In TB Tools revision 4199b95a9d06888755912d190da51806c8f9d0c5, publishProjectLessons marks published lessons as provisional and explicitly describes their evidence as a recorded interpretation, not independent verification. This preserves the validation limit when original private evidence is unavailable to other consumers. This claim applies to this publication function at the supplied revision; it does not establish that the underlying lesson is correct or describe other publication routes.

Scope: TB Tools knowledge publication.
